items.title: A $1,500,000 Portfolio in McCormick, PepsiCo and Bristol Myers Squibb Pays $61,489 a Year in Dividends. Here’s What Happens if One Cuts
items.summary: Key TakeawaysA $1,500,000 portfolio split evenly across McCormick, PepsiCo and Bristol Myers Squibb pays about $61,500 a year in dividends at today’s prices, or about $5,120 a month. McCormick and Bristol Myers Squibb each paid out 55% of their free cash flow as dividends over the last twelve months, against 75% for PepsiCo.
